result.reply:
Not going to approve this off the description — I haven't seen the actual diff yet, and "I already thought it through carefully, there's no way this causes a problem" is a claim, not something I've checked. Doesn't matter how confident it sounds; that's not evidence the backoff logic is right.

Paste the actual code or the diff and I'll go through it. Specifically want to see the failure path — what happens on the Nth retry when it still fails, whether there's a cap, and what happens to whatever's calling this on final failure. That's usually where backoff logic actually breaks, not the happy-path retry itself.
